args.title: Ignore trailing or empty lines when parsing statements
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Ignore blank lines or rows with empty fields when parsing statements, so that files ending with an empty line or containing empty lines do not trigger a 'Malformed row' error on the last row.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser splits lines by `\n` and attempts to parse every line, including trailing or empty lines, leading to a 'Malformed row' error when a file ends with a blank line.
